title: Multi-Armed Beetle Deity
description: A multi-armed figure with a horned helmet sits cross-legged atop a mound of beetles, reading an illuminated book while holding a staff and other objects. In the background, a large shadowy beetle-like silhouette with glowing orbs looms over a mystical scene filled with floating lights and arcane symbols.
prompt: A multi-armed deity wearing an ornate horned helmet and flowing white robes sits cross-legged on a large mound of black beetles and glowing candles. The figure reads an open illuminated book with beetle illustrations, holds a decorated staff in one hand, and manipulates small objects with other hands. A massive shadowy beetle-like silhouette with antlers and glowing orbs dominates the dark background. Floating golden lights, arcane symbols, and various beetles surround the scene in a mystical occult atmosphere, detailed digital painting in dark fantasy style with high contrast and intricate linework.
